bio.text: Catherine Miranda holds the Arizona Senate seat for Legislative District 11; her legislative page gives 2014 as the year she became a member.

According to her legislative biography, she was raised in the Jorgenson neighborhood, served four years in the Arizona House of Representatives before the Senate, and was elected to the Roosevelt School Board in 2008.
The biography says she has served on the board of the National Association of Latino Elected Officials and has two children.
